name: Infinite Scroll
summary: A feed the reader can scroll a long way through, and a sentinel at the end of it that says what comes next. The library cannot load anything: it provides the container, the skipped layout and the sentinel, and the host decides what to load.
summaryZh: 一列可以滚很久的内容,末尾有一个记号,说明下一段会带来什么。库加载不了任何东西:它提供容器、被跳过的排版和那个记号,要加载什么由页面决定。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The feed sits in a panel: the scrolling box draws the frame and the plain fill, and the items sit on it.

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The items take the caption size, so more of them fit in the same height.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The items take the title size.

states.name: Loading
states.note: More is on its way. The state carries the ring the loading component draws — two borders with one side left out.

states.name: Loaded
states.note: The last item has arrived. The line says so, and the reader can stop.

states.name: The end
states.note: There is nothing more. The line says that instead of the loaded one.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the scrolling box, inside the frame: an outside ring would be cut off by the frame that holds it.

parts.name: Scroller
parts.note: The box that scrolls. It carries the overflow, and the host gives it a height, because a box that is not given one never scrolls.

parts.name: Feed
parts.note: The items. It is the part the browser scrolls over and the part the host appends to.

parts.name: Item
parts.note: One entry in the feed. It carries the skip: the browser does not lay out an item that is far from the viewport.

parts.name: Sentinel
parts.note: The last thing in the scrolling box. Its state class says which of the three moments this is.

parts.name: Spinner
parts.note: The ring in the loading state. It is drawn from borders, so it is a shape the stylesheet paints rather than a glyph the library has to ship.

parts.name: Line
parts.note: The words on the line. In the loaded and the end state the line is drawn on either side of them.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which surface the feed is drawn on. The plain run is the base class on its own; the bordered run adds a rule around it.
props.descriptionZh: 这列内容画在哪种表面上。无边框就是只写基类;带边框再加上 um-infinite-scroll--bordered。

props.name: size
props.description: How tall an item is and how big the type in it is.
props.descriptionZh: 每一项有多高,里面的字有多大。

props.name: items
props.description: How many items the feed has. The wrapper writes one item per entry, and the stylesheet skips the ones the reader cannot see.
props.descriptionZh: 这列内容有多少条。包装器一条写一项,样式表跳过读者看不见的那些项。

props.name: state
props.description: Which of the three moments the sentinel is in. It is a class on the sentinel: the wrapper has to be told, because the library cannot know what the host is loading.
props.descriptionZh: 记号处在三个时刻里的哪一个。它是记号上的一个类:包装器得被告知,因为库不知道页面正在加载什么。

props.name: height
props.description: How tall the scrolling box is. The library cannot guess it: a box that is not given a height never scrolls, because its content is what gives it one.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区有多高。库猜不出来:没给高度的盒子不会滚,因为给它高度的是它自己的内容。

a11y.notes: The sentinel carries role="status", so the moment it changes is announced: the words on it say whether more is coming, whether the last item has arrived or whether there is nothing more. The ring beside the words is a picture of waiting rather than a message, so it is marked aria-hidden and the caption carries the meaning. The scrolling box is a real element with overflow on it and a tabindex, so it can be reached with Tab and scrolled with the arrow keys, the page keys and Home and End — the browser's own scrolling, not a script. The library loads nothing: the host decides what to put in the feed, and this component only says where the reader has reached.
a11y.notesZh: 记号上写着 role="status",所以它换状态的时候会被播报:那行字说明是还有下一段、最后一条已经到了、还是已经没有更多了。字旁边那个圆环只是"在等"的样子,不是消息本身,所以它被标成 aria-hidden,让文字去承载那句话。滚动区是一个带 overflow、带 tabindex 的真元素,所以 Tab 能走到它,方向键、翻页键和 Home、End 都能滚它 —— 这是浏览器自己的滚动,不是脚本画的。库不加载任何东西:内容由页面放进去,这个组件只说明读者读到了哪里。

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: Forty-four entries in a box that is shorter than they are, and the ring at the end that says more is coming. The entries the reader cannot see are not laid out: the browser gives them a placeholder size instead.
examples.descriptionZh: 四十四条放在一个比它们矮的盒子里,末尾那个转环说明还有下一段。读者看不见的那些条没有排版,浏览器先给它们一个位置大小。

notes: The library cannot load anything, so the honest division of labour is this: the library provides the container, the skipped layout and the sentinel that says where the reader is, and the host decides what to load. The sentinel's state is a class the markup carries, so the host can change it without the library knowing anything about the data. The items are skipped the way the virtualized components skip their rows, which is the same effect an infinite scroll has in practice: the cost of the list is what is near the viewport. Measured in Chrome 158 on the forty-four items of the example, sixteen of them were skipped and twenty-eight were laid out, and the placeholder is the item's own content height, so the feed measures the same length with the virtualisation on as with it off.
notesZh: 库加载不了任何东西,所以分工只能是這樣:库提供容器、被跳过的排版和那个说明读者读到哪里的记号,要加载什么由页面决定。记号的状态是标记带的一个类,所以页面换状态的时候库不需要知道任何关于数据的事。那些条目的跳过方式和虚拟化组件跳过行是一样的,也正是无限滚动在实际里的效果:这列内容的代价只有离视口近的那部分。在 Chrome 158 上量例子里的四十四条,十六条被跳过,二十八条排了版;那个位置大小就是条目自己的内容高度,所以开着虚拟化和关掉它,这列内容量出来的长度一样。
